text: By the ___ isomorphism, the center $Z(\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g}))$ is isomorphic to the ring of Weyl-invariant polynomials $\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{h}^*]^W$ (via a $\rho$-shift).
explanation: The Harish-Chandra isomorphism identifies $Z(\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g}))$ with $\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{h}^*]^W$, yielding $r$ algebraically independent central (Casimir) generators. It is distinct from PBW (a basis theorem) and from the Weyl character formula (which computes characters of $L(\lambda)$).
